reviews.text:
I always line up the treat packages on the floor and ask my dog, "Which one do you want to eat?"

He really loves the venison I bought here and chooses it quite often 😊
Thank you!!

We visited for the first time on our way back from playing at the dog run in Yoyogi Park! The staff were very kind and the deer bone they recommended has been a hit with our dog and has lasted a long time. We'll definitely come back to buy more treats and toys! The dogs in the shop were adorable too! We look forward to seeing you again!

There's a cute Dachshund in the store!! 🧡 My dog ​​is a Dachshund too, so I bought some treats. I was disappointed that I couldn't buy dried meat treats because I have to take them back to Korea.

But they were so kind in giving me directions, so I bought some dried snacks instead!! 👍 There's Yoyogi Park nearby, so there are lots of dogs walking around!! I want to go back to Korea soon and see my dog!! 😍

Sena, the shop's mascot dog, is very well-behaved and cute, and let us pet him a lot!
I bought a boar, I hope my dog ​​will be happy with it too...
The staff were also very kind and polite.
If you’re looking for some fresh bones for your furry friends, look no further! This is the place!!

I bought freeze-dried chicken breast as a gift for my friend's dog. When I went to give it to the dog as a treat, I found the bag had already been torn open and only the snap-button closure was still attached.

I didn't notice before buying it, but it was an opened product.

My adorable 14-and-a-half-year-old Papillon
Two months ago, she had a tumor (extraosseous osteosarcoma) removed from her mammary gland. Afterwards, the chemotherapy made her even sicker, and she couldn't eat anything. I stopped by this shop, as the vet had said anything she could eat orally would be fine. It was my first time visiting this shop. They recommended the castella cake, which I bought. She seemed to really like it; she wouldn't eat anything else, but she gobbled up the castella.
She's slowly recovering.
It was a real lifesaver.
They also have many other additive-free therapeutic foods, and they listened to my dog's condition.
I plan to go back and buy more suitable products for her.

The staff member was very kind.

They have a lot of unusual snacks, which would make great gifts. I'll definitely visit again! 🐾 …

The staff member was very polite and the shop had a great atmosphere. I tried freeze-dried kangaroo and catfish for the first time, and my dog ​​loved them so much that I bought the kangaroo. He ate it happily, so I'd like to go back and buy more.

I visited for the first time on a weekday lunchtime.
When I asked a question, the staff member carefully explained not only the advantages but also the disadvantages of each product.
There are lead hooks at the cash register, so even if you have a dog (on a lead), you can pay with your hands free.
The wide variety of products is also appealing, so I would like to come again in the future.
It was my first time there, but the staff were friendly and I could sense their love for snacks.

My dog ​​loves this shop and I always get to try their delicious treats. 
They seem to be particular about the ingredients, so I feel they are treats I can give to my dog ​​with confidence. 
The prices are just right for gifts, so I would like to continue using their services.
It seemed like a place where dogs out for a walk could stop by. They were all so cute.
Thank you for your wonderful review 🐶💛 …

My dog ​​goes in on his own. The kind shop staff also give him samples, so he seems to love it. He always buys a big bone and goes on to devour it like he's back in the wild.
He didn't eat the ones I bought online, so the ones I bought here have leftover meat, which is great. I also bought some jerky as a treat. I always stop by here after my AirBuggy has been serviced.

February 2026

I bought some treats from them when they were exhibiting at the "Woof Woof Halloween" event at Pandabashi Bridge in Ueno, and my dog ​​loved them.
I happened to have some business near Yoyogi Park, so I stopped by their physical store.

The appeal of these treats is that they are made with very simple ingredients and are additive-free.
They're treats you can safely give to your dog, so I think they're perfect for everyday use.

They're a trusted dog food and treat store.
Thank you to everyone at the store for your always kind service! I love Kangaroo Achilles tendon and always buy it!
I visited on January 2nd, 2026. It's a lovely shop with a very stylish exterior and interior. ✨

Whenever we pass by, my dog ​​absolutely loves to stop by! 😂
He loves the shop staff who are so kind to him. 🐶 …

I happened to be passing by and was intrigued by the large number of dogs, so I stopped in. The selection of specialty treats was appealing, and the staff kindly explained the different types of food and other options tailored to my dog's needs, which was very helpful.

I bought some kangaroo and sardine retort pouches! The staff gave me a thorough explanation and even let me sample some snacks. My pet seemed very happy with the retort pouch food I bought and devoured it in an instant. I will definitely buy it again!
